svg.title: PGG Engineering tool index
svg.desc: PGG Engineering tool index: 26 products grouped by operation. A grid on the right shows each product’s diagram.

svg.title: Three writes across two keys reduce to two latest rows. The blue terminal row carries a deletion.
A correction at the second event branches from the original timeline to a revised summary below.
Three requests share a prompt prefix. A blue breakpoint sits where their suffixes diverge.
Three aligned telemetry channels shift at different times. The earlier upstream candidate is highlighted for investigation.
A series shifts from one level to another. A blue bracket marks the changed interval for a digest.
Five ballots have been read. The fifth locks the leading count, leaving the last two ballots unopened.
The final bytes of one chunk and the first bytes of the next form a stop string. The output ends at its start.
A point moves through two overlapping rectangular zones. Blue crossings mark changes in membership.
A sequential evidence trace crosses a preset stopping boundary. The crossing is marked in blue.
Two event frames have the same prefix and suffix. The blue segment is the edit carried between them.
Two repeated subsequences align across an observed series. Blue brackets identify their locations.
Two conditions change state in opposite directions after the same update batch.
A moving window contains three event ticks. The blue boundary marks the next expiration while no new events arrive.
Three patch lines are separated into a narrow marker column and their original code.
Two dependency paths converge on one task. The blue segment marks the duration being changed.
A step curve reaches the target cache hit rate. Blue guides locate the associated capacity.
One heartbeat starts three deadline intervals. Blue endpoints show when each reader marks it stale.
Two requests start at different times. The blue backup finishes before the first request.
Three shard streams meet a vertical cutoff. Pages beyond it remain unread.
Two document rows exchange positions after a source revises its ranking. The blue row moves upward.
Ranked-score intervals have separated. The blue cutoff lies between the lowest certified top score and the strongest remaining challenger.
An ensemble member shifts relative to the observation. The remaining forecast members keep their positions.
A single array of changed keys serves three readers. Each reader takes a different prefix.
Three telemetry channels enter a brief. A selected channel retains a handle back to its samples.
A reader cursor separates acknowledged rows from an ordered blue page. Further rows remain available.
A fixed context window feeds a forecast with a fixed horizon. The blue continuation is the prediction.
